errors.text_span: тя стартира при X около 10 със стойност по Y около 0.35, отчита спад при X=30 (Y≈0.35)
errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Alignment' line starts at Y~0.35 and then reports a drop at X=30 to Y~0.35. This is incorrect and misleading. The line actually rises from its starting point (X≈10, Y≈0.34) to a local peak at X=20 (Y≈0.40) before dropping to Y≈0.35 at X=30. The description omits the initial rise, making the statement about a drop nonsensical and misrepresenting the actual trend.

The German word "deutlich" (significantly/clearly) is a subjective interpretation of the magnitude of the increase, which the prompt instructs to avoid. The description should stick to objective reporting of the values.
